name: Telegram for macOS
tagline: Continue your chats, share files, and join calls from Telegram’s native Mac app.
description:
Telegram for macOS is the official native desktop client for Telegram chats, groups, channels, and calls. It brings the service’s cloud-synced messaging to a Mac interface with desktop notifications and file sharing.

Sign in with a Telegram account, continue chats from other devices, send files or media, and manage group or channel conversations from the desktop. Telegram also distributes a separate cross-platform desktop client, so this listing specifically points to its native macOS app.

## Features

- Continue regular cloud chats across Mac and mobile devices.
- Use groups, channels, saved messages, media, and file sharing.
- Make supported voice and video calls from the Mac.
- Use Telegram’s native macOS application distributed through its official site and Mac App Store.

## Where it fits

Telegram fits people and communities already using the service. It is useful for fast multi-device communication, though its privacy model differs from an end-to-end encrypted messenger by default.

## Privacy and requirements

Regular Telegram cloud chats are stored by Telegram so they can sync across devices; do not assume every conversation is end-to-end encrypted. Review current Secret Chat availability and account security before sharing sensitive material. The native macOS client is open source under GPLv2.

## Pricing

Telegram for macOS is free. Optional Telegram Premium features are sold separately by the service.
